research_status: Exploratory conditional replay. The original 38 sessions have already been inspected in other strategy studies; this is not an untouched out-of-sample test.
strike_rule: floor(published lower bound / 5) * 5; require this exact strike, no replacement
size: one naked short SPXW put per available session per independent band series
exit: hold to expiration; no stop, adjustment, protective wing or reinvestment
entry_execution: exact-time bid, finite uncrossed quote, positive bid and bid_size >= 1; no other profitability filter; missing or invalid entry is explicitly skipped
settlement: published SPX cash close independently checked against Yahoo daily close; proxy for official option settlement, not broker records
intraday_risk: minute liquidation at ask with opening and hypothetical closing fees/slippage; no stop is executed; missing/invalid minutes counted; no interpolation
capital: No fixed account ROI or broker margin inferred; report theoretical zero-index loss separately from observed drawdown
publication_caveat: Historical original publication timestamps unverified; assume each forecast was available by 10:00 ET. Sep 16 forecast also appeared in the user-provided prior-session screenshot; no claim of verified pre-10:00 publication.
selection_caveat: Two bands are reported independently. No daily hindsight selection, rule optimization or extrapolation to monthly return.
